name: Agentops
description: Enterprise guardrails, delivery lifecycle, and self-evolution for Claude Code. Wraps every session in 7 security layers (path validation, command validation, injection scanning, credential redaction, exfiltration detection), structures work with the STAR methodology, and orchestrates full project builds from vision to merged PR through an 8.5-phase lifecycle with TDD enforcement, wave-based parallel execution, and two-stage code review. Includes 37 commands, 44 hooks, 12 specialist agents, 49 templates, and 32+ feature flags.
longDescription:
Ships **12 agents**, **18 commands** and **7 hooks**.

- **Agents** (12): `architecture-researcher` (Investigates architectural patterns suitable for a project based on its brief), `code-critic` (Reviews implementation quality, patterns, and suggests improvements), `delegation-router` (Routes tasks to appropriate specialist agents based on task type and complexity), `feature-researcher` (Investigates feature depth, MVP vs v2 scope, and feature trade-offs for a project), `interrogator` (Requirements discovery subagent that analyzes codebases and produces implementation plans), `pitfalls-researcher` (Investigates known failures, anti-patterns, and common pitfalls for a project type), `plan-validator` (Validates a build XML plan across 8 dimensions before execution begins), `proposer` (Analyzes agent execution failures and proposes skill additions or edits), and 4 more
- **Commands** (18): `build` (Master project lifecycle command — orchestrates brainstorm → interrogation → planning → execution → review → approval), `code-analysis` (Run a structured code analysis on the current project or specified path), `code-field` (Apply the Code Field methodology (decompose, solve, verify, synthesize, reflect)), `compliance-check` (Run AgentOps compliance checks manually), `configure` (Unified configuration interface for all AgentOps plugin settings), `cost-report` (Display current session cost tracking and budget status), `evolve` (Run the EvoSkill loop to discover and refine skills from execution failures), `flags` (View or toggle AgentOps feature flags), and 10 more
- **Hooks** (7): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `SubagentStart`, `Stop`, `SessionEnd`

Installs with `claude plugin install agentops@claude-community` from `garethdaine/agentops`.
